name: Sitojaure-Aktse
estimatedTime: 3-4 hours by STF; Naturkartan lists 4-5 hours
description: Sitojaure to Aktse. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Aktse fresh water: Fresh water candidate near Aktse; OSM name-only Fresh water while STF generally says hut guests fetch water from creek/lake.
notes: Route geometry is land-only candidate linework. The Sitojaure/Svijnne boat transport is required before the walking part and current operator details must be checked.

STF route stage lists 10 km / 3-4 h; Naturkartan lists 11.5 km / 4-5 h; an STF FAQ says Sitojaure-Aktse 9 km; STF Aktse facility says Sitojaure is about 13 km north of Aktse; AllTrails lists 9.7 km and Distant North says 9 km hiking plus 4 km lake.
Official/STF text starts with boat transport before hiking; Naturkartan BD63 excludes the boat; OSM relation 18864488 includes the ferry.
Naturkartan BD63 is stored Aktse/Laitaure north landing to Svijnne and excludes exact hut endpoints; OSM is Sitojaure-to-Aktse and hut-proximate.
Route-geometry lane found a working Naturkartan GPX; official-source lane reported no public GPX and API publish_gpx=false.
STF uses Kaskajaure/Kabtajaure and Svine; Naturkartan uses Gasskajaure/Gabddajavrre and Svijnne; Lansstyrelsen uses Sijddojavrre/Sitojaure for discontinued rowing route.
Main route appears just outside or boundary-adjacent to Sarek near Aktse, while Skierfe side trip enters Sarek; exact route-line crossing needs GIS overlay.
